_comment: SAMPLE Uptime Kuma backup-format monitor for TennisAI. Import via Settings > Backup > Import (Uptime Kuma 1.x). The envelope differs between versions; if the import is refused, create an 'HTTP(s) - Keyword' monitor by hand with these values. Replace the hostname if SITE_ADDRESS changes. No notifications are included — attach your own after import.

monitorList.name: TennisAI API health
monitorList.description: GET /api/health must answer 200 with "ok":true. 503 = API up but database down; 502 = API process down; connection error = box down.

monitorList.name: TennisAI status page
monitorList.description: The public /status page is served by Caddy from the SPA bundle; if this fails but the API monitor passes, the web container or the certificate is the problem.
